title: Applied ML experiment scratchpad — quant + prompts
content:
2026-03-26 — scratchpad (Eli)

Goal:
- Quick quantization + prompt-set sanity checks for rw-13B and gpt-neox-20B variants.
- Measure latency/throughput tradeoffs and spot obvious quality regressions on targeted eval suites (summarization, MCQ QA, arithmetic).

Notes / high-level summary:
- Ran baseline fp16 on h100-80gb and a100-40gb to get reference latency numbers.
- Tested q4_k_m (4-bit M+K style) and q8 (8-bit symmetric) profiles using local quant pipeline.
- Observed ~1.6-2.0x throughput increase with q4_k_m vs 8bit on rw-13B under steady-state streaming (seq_len=256).
- Small but measurable drop on arithmetic prompts (addition across long carries) with q4 variants; summarization ROUGE-L stable within 0.5-1.2 points.

Experiment config (runs):
- Models: rw-13B (v1.2), gpt-neox-20B (community-v0.9)
- Hardware: h100-80gb (prod-1), a100-40gb (dev-2)
- Quant profiles: fp16 (baseline), q8_sym, q4_k_m (our default opt), q4_0 (fast, more lossy)
- Batch sizes: 1, 4, 8 for latency; 16, 32 for throughput
- Input distribution: mix of summarization (100 examples), arithmetic (50 examples), MCQ QA (150 examples), chat-style prompts (50 examples)
- Seq len: 128 prompt + 128 gen (most runs); separate long-seq test at 1024 prompt

Quick results (rough):
- rw-13B fp16 @ h100: p50 latency ~42ms/token, throughput (tokens/s) baseline ~23k
- rw-13B q8_sym @ h100: latency ~48ms/token (-), throughput ~28k (+1.2x)
- rw-13B q4_k_m @ h100: latency ~60ms/token, throughput ~40k (+1.8x)
- Notes: latency per token numbers have noise; focus on throughput/quality tradeoffs.

Quality (spot checks):
- Summarization (CNN-style): ROUGE-L delta (q4_k_m vs fp16) ~ -0.8 points — acceptable for many apps.
- MCQ QA: accuracy drop ~1.5% on average for q4_k_m; q4_0 drops ~4-5% (too lossy).
- Arithmetic (small additions across long carries): fp16 solves ~92%, q8_sym ~90%, q4_k_m ~83%, q4_0 ~70%.
- Conclusion: q4_k_m is a good default for throughput-sensitive workloads that are not arithmetic-heavy.

Prompt set (examples used):
1) Summarization prompt:
   "Summarize the following article in 3 bullets: <article_text>"
2) MCQ QA prompt:
   "Question: <q>. Options: A) ... B) ... C) ... D) ... Choose the correct option and explain briefly."
3) Arithmetic stress:
   "Add the following numbers and return exact integer result: 9876543212345678 + 12345678987654321"
4) Chat style (system+user):
   System: "You are a helpful assistant that answers concisely."
   User: "Explain backpropagation in two paragraphs for an engineer."

Immediate TODOs / follow-ups:
- [ ] Re-run q4_k_m with improved KV-cache warmup (prefix caching) to see if latency spike reduces — priority high.
- [ ] Add eval for instruction-following regression (use 200 instruction-following prompts) — Jordan to add list (J: assign).
- [ ] Try partial quant (layerwise: keep first 2 layers fp16) for arithmetic-sensitive workloads.
- [ ] Add quality regression alerts for critical prompts into Redwood Optimize (connect to evals).

Engineering notes / gotchas:
- Observed occasional decoding instability with q4_0 on gpt-neox-20B at high temperature (t>0.8) — causes repeated tokens. Add safety clamp for sampling for now.
- Batch packing helped throughput but increased p95 latency for single-req SLAs — need route-based policy distinction (low-latency vs cost-optimized).

Links / refs:
- PR with quant tool tweaks: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/1234
- Jira ticket for quant eval infra: RD-4567
- Confluence notes (shared): confluence:applied-ml/quant-eval-notes

Notes to self (short):
- If arithmetic quality is a product blocker, consider fallback to fp16 for those routes.
- Try knowledge-distilled variants? low priority — only if cost/perf tradeoffs demand it.
- Save top 20 failure cases from q4_k_m to S3 for deeper analysis (bucket: s3://redwood-ml/quant-fail-cases/2026-03-26).

End of scratchpad.
